comment: Core component tests run by Tests/run_core_tests.py, one process per entry. kind: info = build facts, control = must PASS, defect = known finding (XFAIL when the mechanism is observed, XPASS when it is not). See doc/arkkitehtuuri/testaus.md.

tests.test_case: tp_build_info
tp_build_info
TpCoreHk smoke: sandbox and build constants
tests.expected: PASS: HK core runs in the sandbox

tests.test_case: tp_build_info
tp_build_info
H-025a relay combufsize vs header plus largest class
tests.expected: Correct: combufsize >= 14 + class_len[i] for every class (as in HK). Defect: combufsize == max(class_len) < 14 + max(class_len), at n_os 4 and 30.

tests.test_case: H-025b relay disk queue stores whole packet
tests.expected: Correct: each disk-queue slot holds header + len bytes of the queued packet. Defect: slot stride is combufsize, the last 14 bytes of a largest-class packet are never stored and their file position is the start of the next slot. Checked at n_os 4 (EMITVA) and n_os 30 (YHTEISLAHTOT).

tests.test_case: H-040 control: lock probe and balanced lock use
tests.expected: PASS: probe sees free/held/free; production delfrec leaves kilpdat_CriticalSection free (RecursionCount 0)

tests.test_case: H-040 relay addfrec leaves kilpdat_CriticalSection held
tests.expected: Correct: after addfrec returns, another thread can enter kilpdat_CriticalSection. Defect: another thread cannot; the caller still owns it.

tests.test_case: H-042 control: in-limit KilpSrj.xml is read
tests.expected: PASS: luesarjat returns 0 with n_os = n_os_akt = MAXOSUUSLUKU, valuku = VAIKALUKU

tests.test_case: H-042 relay XML counts above compile-time limits
tests.expected: Correct: file rejected or counts clamped to MAXOSUUSLUKU / VAIKALUKU. Defect: luesarjat returns 0 and kilpparam keeps n_os = n_os_akt = MAXOSUUSLUKU+1, valuku = VAIKALUKU+1.

tests.test_case: H-041a HK record size vs KILPBUFSIZE at shipped limits
tests.expected: Correct: with n_pv = N_PV (5) and valuku = VALUKU (250), which the only limit (Hk/HkSrj.cpp:158) accepts, kilprecsize <= KILPBUFSIZE (10000). Defect: kilprecsize > KILPBUFSIZE. Configuration fact computed by the production luekentat; the limit check itself is not exercised (setStages calls luekentat directly).

tests.test_case: H-041b3 HK pack writes past KILPBUFSIZE (heap guard)
tests.expected: Proxy evidence: the production pack() writes exactly kilprecsize bytes, more than KILPBUFSIZE, the size of the stack buffer write/read/addfrec pass to it (that link is by reading the code; H-041b2 shows the actual overrun). Correct: pack writes at most KILPBUFSIZE bytes.

tests.test_case: H-041b2 HK write overflows its stack buffer (ASan)
tests.expected: Correct: kilptietue::write(1, 0) runs without an ASan report. Defect: ASan reports a stack-buffer-overflow WRITE on variable buf (10000 bytes) in frame kilptietue::write.

tests.test_case: H-031 control: allowed stage change proceeds
tests.expected: PASS: an allowed first stage change sets k_pv = 1, clears vaiheenvaihto and leaves tall/ajat/emit locks free

tests.test_case: H-031 refused stage change blocks a later allowed change
tests.expected: Correct: after a refused change, a later allowed change proceeds (k_pv = 1). Defect: vaiheenvaihto stays set, the later call returns 0 and does nothing.

tests.test_case: H-008 control: lock probe and early error path
tests.expected: PASS: probe sees free/held/free; an unknown bib returns before the lock and leaves tall_CriticalSection free

tests.test_case: H-008 control: valid penalty message releases the lock
tests.expected: PASS: a valid penalty message takes and leaves tall_CriticalSection (lsak 3), stores the penalty, no message

tests.test_case: H-008 HK tall_sak error path leaves tall_CriticalSection held
tests.expected: Correct: after the -3 error path returns, another thread can take tall_CriticalSection. Defect: the lock stays owned by the (ended) worker thread.

tests.test_case: H-024 control: mismatching TARKT packet releases the lock
tests.expected: PASS: a mismatching TARKT packet is consumed, two messages, tall_CriticalSection free

tests.test_case: H-024 relay tark_trk announcer path leaves tall_CriticalSection held
tests.expected: Correct: after the TARKT packet is processed, another thread can take tall_CriticalSection. Defect: the lock stays owned by the ended tarkcom worker.

tests.test_case: H-027 control: attempt listener counts and rejects or accepts
tests.expected: PASS: the 127.0.0.1 listener counts one rejected and one accepted attempt

tests.test_case: H-027a TCP client does not retry after a failed connect
tests.expected: Correct: after a failed first attempt the client thread keeps running and connects when the listener accepts (retry about every 4-6 s). Defect: one attempt that fails, the thread ends, no attempt in the next 15 s.

tests.test_case: H-027b TCPXML client dereferences a freed connection
tests.expected: Correct: no crash; the client retries. Defect: read access violation at 0x0000000C (TCPyhteys[yhtno]->ipparam with NULL) in reconnectTCP on the client thread.

tests.test_case: H-032 control: in-limit packet stays inside the receive block
tests.expected: PASS: an in-limit TARKT packet on the last slot leaves the guard after the receive block untouched

tests.test_case: H-032a relay addseur copies an unchecked length past the receive block
tests.expected: Correct: a class-7 datagram of len 1000 is rejected or limited to the slot. Defect: addseur copies len+14 bytes into the last slot and overwrites exactly (INBUFL-1)*S+1014-(INBUFL+1)*S bytes after the production-sized block with packet data.

tests.test_case: H-032b relay addseur heap-buffer-overflow (ASan)
tests.expected: Correct: no ASan report. Defect: ASan heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1014 in addseur on the calloc(INBUFL+1, sizeof(combufrec)) block.

tests.test_case: H-026 control: valid packets are consumed and the loop stops
tests.expected: PASS: two valid packets consumed, loop ends after comfl = 0

tests.test_case: H-026 relay unknown packet class stops receiving permanently
tests.expected: Correct: the unknown class is skipped and the next packet processed. Defect: inbens stays at the unknown packet, the next valid packet is never processed and the loop keeps spinning after comfl = 0 (worker left running).

tests.test_case: H-022 control: stage packet for the right competitor is stored
tests.expected: PASS: VAIN_TULOST with the matching bib is stored on record 1, lock free

tests.test_case: H-022 HK stage packet applied to a different competitor
tests.expected: Correct: a stage packet whose bib does not match the record is rejected. Defect: it is stored on the record like the matching one.

tests.test_case: H-023a HK stage result applied to the receiver's own stage
tests.expected: Correct: a VAIN_TULOST for stage 2 is stored on stage 2 or rejected. Defect: it is stored on the receiver stage 1 (k_pv 0).

tests.test_case: H-023b control: other-stage link without change request is refused
tests.expected: PASS: link request from stage 2 without change flag is refused

tests.test_case: H-023b control: allowed stage change request is carried out
tests.expected: PASS: with an empty queue the requested change is made and the link accepted

tests.test_case: H-023b HK link accepted although the stage change was refused
tests.expected: Correct: if the requested stage change is refused, the link is refused. Defect: the change is refused (k_pv stays 0) but tark_alku accepts the link.

tests.test_case: H-007 control: waiter probe on a CRITICAL_SECTION
tests.expected: PASS: waiter count 0 when only held, 1 while another thread is blocked

tests.test_case: H-007 HK received packet overwrites a concurrent local change
tests.expected: Correct: a local change made while the receive thread waits for tall_CS survives. Defect: the receive thread saves the copy it read before the lock and the change is lost.

tests.test_case: H-001a relay textjtulos clears past stsk (ASan)
tests.expected: Correct: the memset stays inside stsk (40 bytes). Defect: ASan stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 160 (sizeof(st)) at Juk/VTulostus.cpp:2228 in a textjtulos stack frame.

tests.test_case: H-001b relay textosuus clears past stsk (ASan)
tests.expected: Correct: the memset stays inside stsk (40 bytes). Defect: ASan stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 160 (sizeof(st)) at Juk/VTulostus.cpp:3981 in a textosuus stack frame.

tests.test_case: H-002 control: legacy line with 7 fields writes nothing to 0x30303030
tests.expected: PASS: the legacy file is parsed (class H21, 1 leg) and nothing is written to the reserved page

tests.test_case: H-002a relay legacy 6-field line writes through paikat[0] value
tests.expected: Correct: the 6th token is stored in Sarjat[0].paikat or rejected. Defect: "4242" is written to address 0x30303030 (the int value of paikat[0]).

tests.test_case: H-002b relay legacy 9-field line writes through paikat[0] value
tests.expected: Correct: the 9th token is stored in Sarjat[0].paikat or rejected. Defect: "TPH002" is written to address 0x30303030.

tests.test_case: HK synthetic KilpSrj.xml for black-box run 1 is read
tests.expected: PASS: the synthetic series file of black-box run 1 is read by the production luesarjat (0, no messages); n_pv 1, valuku 2, sarjaluku 1, kilprecsize 544
